messages:
marcus: Quick catch-up: outreach for the Cost & Latency optimizer yielded 18 signups. Need a crisp plan to finalize cohort by Friday.

elaine: We should cap initial cohort to 8-10 active partners (6-week run). Beyond that we need extra SE onboarding capacity.

sophie: I can add two onboarding slots if runbooks are locked. I'll take ownership of the intake form and week-0 checklist.

raj: Eng needs to expose DP tags + per-request token counter + latency percentiles before we route partner traffic. ETA?

lina: Minimal telemetry list to wire dashboards: p50_ms, p95_ms, tokens_per_request, cost_per_1000, error_rate_5m. Also a boolean "dp_session" tag.

elaine: Incentives proposal: $5k cloud credits + 6mo Redwood Optimize + co-marketing mention. Legal + data consent required.

legal-bot: NDA template dp-nda-v3 available at /legal/dp-nda. Standard turnaround 48h, tag dp-urgent to expedite.

ben: Acceptance criteria draft:
- workload: high token volume or long-context use
- impact: measurable cost/latency pain
- commitment: 2x eng + weekly check-ins
- telemetry consent + no compliance block

marcus: Success signals: partner reports stable UX; system metrics show <2% error regression. Bonus (stretch): >=10% reduction in cost/token.

sophie: Proposed schedule:
Day0: finalize intake + NDA + telemetry checklist
Day2: notify acceptances
Wk0: onboarding call + 48h baseline capture
Wk1-5: weekly syncs + prompt/eval loops
Wk6: demo + decision

elaine: Recruitment close rule: accept until 10 confirmed OR Fri EOD. If oversubscribed, prioritize by token volume, engineering readiness, and story potential.

onboard-bot: Created scaffold tickets for 8 partners and added weekly sync placeholders. Links posted in #product.

raj: I'll add a smart-routing flag "dp_experiment" to pin to fallback-safe variants during tests.

marcus: Great. Elaine, Sophie, Ben  please post final intake link and runbook updates here when ready.
